rules.description: FTP management service is enabled
rules.remediation: If FTP is not required, disable it: /ip service set ftp disabled=yes

rules.description: Telnet management service is enabled
rules.remediation: If Telnet is not required, disable it and use SSH: /ip service set telnet disabled=yes

rules.description: HTTP web management service is enabled
rules.remediation: If web management is not required, disable it: /ip service set www disabled=yes

rules.description: API management service is enabled
rules.remediation: If API is not required, disable it: /ip service set api disabled=yes

rules.description: API-SSL management service is enabled
rules.remediation: If API-SSL is not required, disable it: /ip service set api-ssl disabled=yes

rules.description: PPTP VPN server is enabled; PPTP is considered insecure
rules.remediation: Prefer a modern VPN protocol; plan and test migration before disabling PPTP

rules.description: RouterOS NTP client server is configured
rules.remediation: Configure an approved NTP server

rules.description: Remote syslog action is configured and referenced by a logging rule
rules.remediation: Configure a remote logging action and reference it from the required /system logging rules

rules.description: SNMP service is enabled
rules.remediation: Disable SNMP if not required; otherwise restrict access and use SNMPv3 where supported

rules.description: Default admin account is present
rules.remediation: Create and verify a named administrator before disabling or removing the default admin account

rules.description: Admin password strength/policy cannot be verified without exposing secrets
rules.remediation: Verify administrator credentials and organizational password controls through an approved secure process; do not export passwords

rules.description: SSH strong-crypto is enabled
rules.remediation: Enable strong-crypto after checking client compatibility

rules.description: MAC server is restricted to a management interface list
rules.remediation: Restrict MAC server to a dedicated management interface list

rules.description: MAC Winbox is restricted to a management interface list
rules.remediation: Restrict MAC Winbox to a dedicated management interface list

rules.description: Neighbor discovery is restricted to a management interface list
rules.remediation: Restrict neighbor discovery to a dedicated management interface list

rules.description: SSH service lacks an address restriction
rules.remediation: Restrict SSH service address to approved management subnets

rules.description: Winbox service lacks an address restriction
rules.remediation: Restrict Winbox service address to approved management subnets

rules.description: Input firewall chain has an enabled final drop rule
rules.remediation: Review input-chain rule order and add an explicit final drop after required management allowances

rules.description: Router DNS resolver accepts remote requests
rules.remediation: Disable allow-remote-requests unless this router is an intentionally scoped DNS resolver

rules.description: Bandwidth-test server is enabled
rules.remediation: Disable the bandwidth-test server unless operationally required and access-restricted

rules.description: RouterOS version meets the configured minimum
rules.remediation: Plan a tested upgrade to the organization's approved RouterOS minimum version
